equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet; retained stake after FY2025 JV disposal. Its share of result (H1 HK$39.1m) is excluded from the EBITDA path, so the asset goes in the bridge.

equity_bridge.item: H1 FY2026 owner FCF already in 30-Jun cash
equity_bridge.note: H1 FCF 596.0 (OCF 727.3 - PP&E capex 131.2) less SBC 77.8, interest income 52.0, lease cash 138.9. Year 1 of the projection is the full FY2026, so this half is removed from the bridge to avoid a double count.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (+5.3%) diverges sharply from revenue (-1.3%) and EPS (-11.4%) 5yr CAGRs because FY2025 is a cycle trough; all trailing CAGRs are end-point artefacts of the semiconductor capex cycle and are not used to set the forward path, which is anchored to FY2026 guidance and a through-cycle margin.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF (OCF - PP&E capex) - SBC - interest income, before lease cash. FCF CAGRs are undefined because FY2025 owner FCF is negative (trough + working-capital build). Owner-FCF fell faster than reported FCF over FY2022-25 as interest income rose with the cash pile; SBC itself fell (FY2024 HK$220m -> FY2025 HK$110m).

scenario_narratives.base: ASMPT delivers the guided FY2026 (revenue ~HK$19bn, +38%) on TCB, high-end die bonders, photonics and an AI-server-board SMT lift, and FY2027 grows a further 10% on the 1.43x book-to-bill. The base then takes the cycle seriously: a FY2028 digestion year (-8%, EBITDA margin 16%) like FY2019 and FY2023, after which advanced packaging keeps a structural tailwind (TCB TAM >US$1.6bn by 2028, 30-40% share) while SMT grows with electronics. Terminal EBITDA margin 18% sits between the through-cycle average (~15.5%) and the FY2021-22 peak (22%), crediting the mix shift to higher-margin SEMI without assuming peak economics persist; owner-FCF margin matures around 9% versus ~7% historically after lease cash.
scenario_narratives.bull: The AI advanced-packaging build-out proves structural rather than cyclical: HBM4 delivers memory-TCB share gains via the exclusive joint evaluation, the second-generation hybrid-bonding platform qualifies against Besi, co-packaged optics ramps on top of the tripled transceiver business, and panel-level packaging adds a new leg. No digestion year; revenue roughly 2.7x FY2025 by FY2035 and the SEMI-heavy mix takes group EBITDA margin to 24%, closer to pure-play advanced-packaging peers. Exit multiple 16x.
scenario_narratives.bear: Hyperscaler and HBM capex pauses in 2027-28 (as in the FY2023 trough), and US/allied export controls are extended to back-end packaging and SMT tools or China retaliates, impairing the ~42% China revenue base. Hybrid bonding goes to Besi, SMT faces Japanese price competition, and the CEO transition (Robin Ng to Bassel Haddad) slows execution. Revenue falls 25% over two years from the FY2026 peak and EBITDA margin troughs at 10.5% before settling at 13.5%; exit multiple 12x.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value ASMPT through the cycle, not at its trough (FY2025 owner FCF negative) or its current AI-driven upswing. The base case honours FY2026 guidance, includes one digestion year, and capitalises a near-through-cycle margin at a cyclical 14x cap. The current price sits above the base and close to the bull case, i.e. the market is pricing the AI advanced-packaging cycle as structural.
key_risks_to_valuation: Semiconductor capex cyclicality: timing and depth of the next digestion year dominate the explicit-period value
US/allied export controls on China (~42% of 1H2026 revenue) or Chinese counter-measures
Hybrid-bonding qualification against Besi decides whether the next packaging wave is captured
Terminal margin: each 1pp of terminal EBITDA margin is worth roughly HK$5-6/share in the base
Working-capital intensity (~42% of revenue) makes growth cash-hungry and downturns cash-generative, so FCF lags earnings in the upswing

inputs.share_count_basis: 419.41m shares in issue at 30-Jun-2026 (share capital HK$41.941m at HK$0.10 par, H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet); above the 418.63m H1 diluted weighted average, so used as the fully diluted count. Held FLAT: the Employee Share Incentive Scheme issues new shares, and that dilution is charged as SBC in the flows (charging both would double-count).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual cash flow statement add-back 'Share-based payments under the Scheme' HK$109.784m (line 4099); no net-share-settlement tax withholding disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every period). H1 FY2026 equity-statement charge HK$77.8m (0.87% of revenue).
inputs.wacc_rationale: HKD flows; HKD is pegged to USD so the rate is built on a USD basis: risk-free ~4.3% (10y UST) + beta ~1.05 x 5.0% ERP = ~9.5% cost of equity. Net cash, so WACC = cost of equity. Same 9.5% in every scenario: semiconductor-capex cyclicality, China export-control exposure and AI-capex digestion risk are carried in the scenario paths and weights, not in a WACC premium (charge risk once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: full lease cash (FY2025 principal HK$219.3m + interest HK$63.6m = 2.06% of revenue; H1 FY2026 HK$109.1m + HK$29.8m = 1.56%) charged via lease_cost_pct_path; da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (H1 FY2026 PP&E 173.4 + inv. prop 3.3 + intangibles 45.7 = HK$222.4m, 2.5% of revenue); lease liabilities (HK$1,706.5m at 30-Jun-2026) EXCLUDED from net debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is nil at 30-Jun-2026 (HK$106.6m at Dec-2025 left with NEXX on deconsolidation, 3-Jun-2026). No NCI deduction.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, with the non-US/cyclical adaptations (routing table row 'Operating company, non-US or cyclical'). ASMPT is an operating equipment maker (SEMI back-end/advanced packaging ~57%, SMT placement ~43%) with a net-cash balance sheet -- no bank/REIT/holdco features; first valuation, no prior model decision in memory. CYCLICAL BASE: FY2025 is a trough (OCF HK$242.5m, reported FCF -HK$139.1m, owner FCF -HK$342.4m) and H1 FY2026 is a sharp AI-driven recovery (book-to-bill 1.43x). Neither is extrapolated: the forward flows are built from components, the base path includes an explicit FY2028 digestion year, and the terminal margin is set near through-cycle levels (FY2019-25 average pre-lease owner FCF HK$1,438m on HK$16.2bn revenue = 8.9%; ~7.3% after lease cash) lifted modestly for the AI/TCB mix shift. FY2026 growth anchors to guidance: H1 HK$8,902.6m + Q3 guide US$630-690m (~HK$5.15bn mid) + Q4 at a similar level => ~HK$19.3bn, ~+40%; base takes +38%. FY0 base revenue is FY2025 continuing operations (NEXX excluded; sold to Applied Materials 3-Jun-2026). EBITDA margin is operating EBITDA ex share of associate (associate held in the bridge at book, matching-asset rule) and after restructuring 'other expenses'; H1 FY2026 ran ~16.4% after other expenses / ~17.8% before. Interest income (FY2025 HK$93.5m) stripped from the owner-FCF base because HK$3.63bn net cash is added in the bridge. Working capital: manufacturer with net operating WC ~42% of annualised revenue (inventory 7.25bn + receivables 5.43bn - payables 3.23bn - customer advances 1.95bn), so wc_capture is NEGATIVE (-20% of the revenue change): growth consumes cash, downturns release it. Cash tax ramps from ~24% (H1 FY2026 ETR 32% on loss-making units) to 21% (blend of Singapore, China, Germany; FY2022 cash rate 26%, FY2021 14%). Buybacks: none since FY2022 (HK$168m); the flat count is a modelling convention funded by the SBC charge, not by repurchases. Timing: balance sheet is 30-Jun-2026 but year 1 is full FY2026, so H1 FY2026 owner FCF already sitting in cash is deducted in the equity bridge to avoid counting it twice. SBC-near-zero market: SBC ~1% of revenue, so house and street are close but not identical; band_position is reported but carries little information.

bear.narrative: AI/HBM capex digestion from 2027 coincides with export controls extended to back-end/SMT tools, cutting the ~42% China book; hybrid bonding lost to Besi; margins revert to the FY2023-24 trough band and recover only to 13.5%.

base.narrative: Guided AI-led FY2026 (+38%), a further TCB/photonics-driven FY2027, then a digestion year (-8%) as in FY2019/FY2023, and mid-single-digit structural growth thereafter; terminal EBITDA margin 18% vs ~15.5% FY2018-25 average and 22% at the FY2021-22 peak.

bull.narrative: Structural AI advanced-packaging super-cycle without a digestion year; memory TCB wins on HBM4, hybrid bonding qualified, CPO ramps; SEMI mix lifts group EBITDA margin to 24%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 14x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: the valuation date sits in a sharp upcycle (book-to-bill 1.43x, highest since 1H2021) for a business whose history is a deep trough every 2-4 years, and ~42% of revenue is exposed to a single regulatory axis (US export controls on China). Base 50% is the guided recovery plus one digestion. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things to go right at once -- no digestion, memory-TCB share gains, a hybrid-bonding win against an incumbent, and CPO -- during a CEO transition.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
